_comment: Minimum acceptable MEDIAN Lighthouse performance score (0-1) per URL, checked by ci-gate.js against `shopify theme dev` on a CI runner (NOT production). Desktop scores on the runner are stable (observed home 74-85, product 84-89, collection 82-86) so their floors are observed_min - ~10pts and catch a real regression. MOBILE scores swing wildly on shared runners through the dev proxy (collection/mobile has ranged 0.38-0.61 run to run) so mobile floors are set to 0.25 -- a 'the page still renders' check only; mobile perf regressions are caught by field data (backlog P1-1), not here. Recalibrate desktop after deliberate perf work; leave mobile.
